notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten 4th-of-July notes list Lewistown, 406-535-5436, and say a June 3 call resulted in the company number being forwarded to the committee. Adventure Zone has prior email outreach to Lewistown's 4th of July Celebration. Source: handwritten call notes, page 88; Adventure Zone Gmail.
